title: If You Feel Forgotten by God in This Season, Watch This Before You Sleep
text: Romans 8:28, result together. Every single thing. Not some things, not the comfortable things, not the things that make sense. All things, every bit, every false accusation, every dungeon, every forgotten promise, every lost chance, every door that closed, every relationship that ended, every dream that seemed to die, every setback, every betrayal, every miscarriage, every bankruptcy, every disappointment, every disappointment. All of it is being worked together right now by the God who holds all things in his hands. And it is working together for good, not for destruction, not for your humiliation, not for your permanent defeat, for good, for your good, for the good that God planned before the foundation of the world, for the good that is so much better than what you lost that when you get there, you will understand why the road went through the wilderness. Father, right now I decree the surge over this person's life. Every broken piece of their story, God, you are working it together right now. Every fragment of pain, every shattered dream, every failed attempt, every year that felt wasted, you are weaving together right now into a tapestry of purpose. This person cannot see the full picture from where they are standing. They can only see the back of the tapestry where all the threads look tangled and knotted and confusing, but you are working from the front.
